problems.what: spice_measure value_at on a '.db' (or '.phase_deg') column returns the number with unit 'volt'.
problems.evidence: Re-run in-process: spice_measure(csv_file=<run>/ws/20261026T041305Z-f1ac5f0b-spice_simulate/result.csv, measurement='value_at', column='v(out).db', at='1 kHz') -> value {quantity: 42.1104, unit: 'volt'}. Cause: eng_toolkit/domains/spice/measure.py:175 sets unit from the 'v(' prefix of the column name.
problems.fix: measure.py:175: unit 'decibel' (or dimensionless with a 'dB' note) for '.db', 'degree' for '.phase_deg', dimensionless for '.re/.im' ratios of ac tables; keep volt/ampere only for plain transient/op columns.

problems.what: The column description promises "ac tables: 'v(out)' picks v(out).mag or v(out).db", but value_at with column='v(out)' is refused (only bandwidth_3db resolves it).
problems.evidence: Re-run: value_at column='v(out)' on the ac result.csv -> input.invalid "'column' 'v(out)' is not in the file; columns: v(out).re, v(out).im, v(out).mag, v(out).db, v(out).phase_deg"; description at measure.py:244.
problems.fix: Make _resolve map 'v(out)' to '.mag' (or '.db') for every measurement on an ac table, or narrow the description to bandwidth_3db.

problems.what: No measurement for a band-pass response: bandwidth_3db is low-pass only (reference = first sample), so the lower corner of any AC-coupled amplifier needs manual bracketing (the assistant made 11 value_at calls to find 190 Hz and 420 kHz).
problems.evidence: Re-run: bandwidth_3db column='v(out)' -> measure.not_found 'the gain never falls 3.0103 dB below its first sample ... (or this is not a low-pass response)', details first_gain_db -18.95.
problems.fix: Add measurement 'corners_3db' (reference = maximum gain; returns peak gain and frequency, lower and upper -3.0103 dB crossings interpolated in log f, or 'none within the sweep'), or a 'reference=peak' option for bandwidth_3db.

problems.what: AC phase is wrapped to (-180, 180]; for an inverting amplifier it jumps from -180 to +180 in the middle of the passband, and plot_xy draws a vertical line there.
problems.evidence: rendered/20261026T041309Z-ed00532f-plot_xy_plot.png at ~9 kHz; assistant had to explain '實際仍是 −220° 左右'.
problems.fix: spice_simulate: add an unwrapped phase column (v(out).phase_unwrapped_deg), or plot_xy option 'unwrap_phase'.

problems.what: plot_xy legend truncates the y2 series label ('v(out).phase_deg (right ax...') and there is no parameter to rename a CSV series; log-axis tick labels mix plain and exponent formats (10000, 100000, 1e6, 1e7).
problems.fix: Widen the legend box to fit labels or allow 'y_labels' to rename series; use one tick format per axis (1, 10, 100, 1k, 10k ... or 10^n).

problems.what: Turn 1 ran the full analysis on assumed coupling capacitor and source impedance instead of asking first, costing one turn; and it tried raw ngspice via Bash before loading the eng-toolkit skill.

problems.fix: eng-toolkit SKILL.md already says 'Always load it before calling any mcp__eng-toolkit__* tool' and rule 7; add to the electronics line: 'for an amplifier ask source impedance, coupling/bypass capacitors and load before the ac run'.

what_worked: Read KiCad's model file, noticed it is only bf=200, pasted the line (since .include is refused) and stated that the upper corner from it is meaningless.

Used the person's datasheet values (Cibo -> cje, Cobo -> cjc, fT -> tf) to get an upper corner of about 420 kHz, within about 10 % of the full PSpice model's 469 kHz, with a Miller hand estimate (345 kHz) as a check.
Ran the transient long enough (window at 100 ms) to avoid the coupling-capacitor start-up, and reconciled the waveform gain (126.5) with the ac gain (127.0).
Explained band-pass bandwidth and the 0.15 dB difference between 1 kHz and the plateau correctly (10 log10(1 + (190/1000)^2)).
Charts have titles, axis labels with units, log frequency axis and a second axis; the requested 1 Hz-10 MHz range was produced on request.
